bifrost: springboard/bifrostd/src/lib.rs, springboard/proto/src/lib.rs, springboard/sdk/src/control.rs, springboard/sdk/src/notification.rs, springboard/sdk/src/runtime.rs, springboard/sdk/src/process_info.rs, springboard/sdk/src/service_management.rs, springboard/src/bin/portal.rs, docs/privd-protocol.md
summary: BifrOSt has no XPC API for apps: no XPCSession, XPCListener, XPC activities or XPC event handlers. It covers part of the same job with a service supervisor (bifrostd, restarts services with backoff), a root daemon contract (privd), an owner-only JSON-RPC control socket per app, in-process and distributed notifications, and ProcessInfo activities that keep an app running in the background.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 3 (theme-21, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No SDK type for typed peer-to-peer sessions with a listener. The control socket is one request per connection and is served by the app for agents and tools, not for app-to-app messaging. The shell-to-app protocol is internal and not exposed to apps.

features.feature: XPC services launched on demand, shut down when idle, restarted on crash
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/service_client.rs (ServiceClient::connect, ping, call; ServiceId; socket_path); springboard/bifrostd/src/lib.rs (socket activation on the first connection, restart with backoff, new version swapped in after a ping); springboard/sdk/src/service_management.rs (SMAppService, mainApp only)
features.note: An app connects to a service socket and the supervisor starts the service on that first connection; the client's connect, ping, call, timeout and disconnect paths are tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-rest-14.rs. Gap: services are never shut down when idle, an app cannot declare a service in its manifest, and the lab machine has not confirmed that a sandboxed app reaches a live service.

features.apple: XPC services with privileged LaunchDaemon (via Service Management)
features.bifrost: docs/privd-protocol.md (contract for the root daemon bifrost-privd, proto 1); springboard/src/bin/portal.rs (D-Bus org.freedesktop.portal.Settings service)
features.note: The blocker is access, not the protocol: bifrost-privd accepts a connection only from the shell, bifrost-mcp or a root tool (checked by the peer executable path), and the app sandbox never binds its socket, so no app can call it. The portal is a D-Bus service for Linux toolkit apps, not an XPC counterpart.

features.apple: XPC activities (xpc_activity_register, criteria, defer and check-in)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/process_info.rs (ActivityOptions: USER_INITIATED, LATENCY_CRITICAL, BACKGROUND, IDLE_SYSTEM_SLEEP_DISABLED); springboard/sdk/src/runtime.rs:213 (beginActivity keeps an app running after it leaves the foreground); springboard/sdk/src/activity_schedule.rs (ActivityCriteria, ActivitySchedule, run_if_due); tests: springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-38.rs
features.note: Activity criteria with an interval, a tolerance and repeats, and a schedule that decides wait, run or finished and runs work when due, are tested headless. Gap: the scheduler is an in-process model driven by the caller's clock, so the system does not run it, and the shell's throttling hints are not tied to it; the lab machine must verify the system behaviour.

features.feature: XPC events (on-demand IOKit and notification events)
features.apple: XPC events (IOKit matching, system notifications delivered to a service)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/notification.rs (NotificationCenter, DistributedNotificationCenter add_observer, post, post_with); tests: springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01b.rs; springboard/sdk/src/workspace.rs (NSWorkspace-style calls)
features.note: Named notifications work inside the app process, with a distributed variant that posts through the shell. Nothing wakes a service from a device or IOKit event. Headless tests (headless_notification_center_* in sdk/tests) cover observer filtering, removal, the distributed namespace, and that post_with asks the shell to relay the post while the sender's observers hear it. Delivery to other running apps depends on the shell and was not verified on Midget.

features.apple: XPC objects (xpc_dictionary_t, xpc_array_t, xpc_string_t and others)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/coding.rs (Codable and plist); bifrost_core::json (JSON values used by control and intent calls)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 11 tests. Messages are JSON or plist, not XPC objects. Apps that already use Codable or JSON can exchange data, but there is no typed XPC object model or XPC-compatible wire format.

features.feature: XPC connections and endpoints (XPCEndpoint, anonymous listeners)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 3 (theme-21, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No endpoint objects that can be passed between processes, and no peer requirement or code-signing check. Access control is owner-UID only.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/control.rs (SO_PEERCRED owner check); springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (bubblewrap sandbox policy for apps)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. The owner UID check covers same-user access. There is no requirement on bundle identity, signing or entitlements, because BifrOSt has no code-signing peer check.

gaps: No SDK API for XPC-style typed sessions between an app and a helper (XPCListener, XPCSession, XPCReceivedMessage).
No app-facing way to declare a helper service that the system launches on demand and shuts down when idle. bifrostd only restarts services.
No XPC activity scheduler (criteria, intervals, deferral, system-run callback) in the SDK.
No endpoint objects for passing a connection to another process, and no peer requirement beyond the owner UID.
No event wake-up for services from device or IOKit events.
